content: Hi all, I realise that I didn't adhere to the correct etiquette by introducing myself when starting using this last time. I am a masters student at Imperial, doing the formalising maths course and also doing a lean-based project. Still very much a newbie at this stage (and so my questions will be correspondingly simplistic), but certainly hoping to improve in the next few months!

Hi, I’m Steven Herbert. I was previously a mature student at Imperial College when I took a bit of time out from my career to study the Pure Maths MSc there — and got fascinated by the world of mathematical formalisation. 

Since then, for tedious work-related reasons I had to disconnect from the Lean scene completely… but I’ve left that job, and so I am now back here. (Hopefully now for good.) My principal field is the theory of quantum computation and information, and I’m actively exploring what can be done in terms of formalisation.

I’m looking for general reconnection; what events are on in the Cambridge / London area; + I am particularly keen to meet people who are interested in AI for maths and auto-formalisation.
Welcome! Are you the same Steven Herbert as the one that posted before you?
Yes indeed! (Although now have an account associated with my Cambridge rather than Imperial email, so appear as a new user.)
